data.narrative:
Defense Unicorns, a Series B defense & security company founded by Rob Slaughter, Jeff McCoy, and Andrew Greene, is valued at $1.0B+ post-money. The peer universe consists of 2 public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private defense-tech companies at similar stages, including Dream Security ($3.0B), Harmattan AI ($1.4B), Code Metal ($1.2B), Castelion ($1.0B), and Heven AeroTech ($1.0B).

Two triangulation methods apply directly. Stage-progression analysis, applying a typical 1.9x Series B step-up multiplier to the last post-money valuation of $1.0B, implies $1.9B. Peer-median methodology across six same-sector, same-stage comparables yields a median of $1.1B, with a range spanning $300M to $3.0B. The peer set exhibits material dispersion; the median ($1.1B) sits 37% below the top quartile (Dream Security at $3.0B).

Triangulating both methods produces a range of $956M to $2.2B, with a median of $1.5B. The current $1.0B+ valuation sits at the lower bound, consistent with typical Series B post-money floors. Key uncertainties include whether Defense Unicorns' operational metrics—revenue, profitability, customer concentration, contract duration—align with higher-valued peers like Dream Security or the lower-valued median. Defense & Security valuations exhibit outsized sensitivity to government contract wins and regulatory tailwinds, both of which remain undisclosed in available data.
